description: Validates that a boundary's UI Model exists in the D-02 shape, is empty with an explanation where UI does not apply, and carries boundary provenance on every entry. Run with --boundary pointing at the boundary folder.

checks.description: ui-model.json and ui-model.md must exist, even when the model is deliberately empty
checks.remediation: Run ui-generatemodel; for a boundary where UI does not apply it writes an empty model with a generation_note instead of omitting the file

checks.description: A non-software boundary's ui-model.json must have an empty entries array
checks.remediation: UI may only exist in explicitly software-typed boundaries (R-011, contract Section 2.2)

checks.description: A model with zero entries must carry a generation_note explaining why
checks.remediation: An empty entries array must always be accompanied by an explicit generation_note

checks.description: Every entry must keep the D-02 fields the screen pipeline reads
checks.remediation: Do not remove or restructure the existing UIModelEntry fields; the provenance fields are additive

checks.description: Every entry this skill produces must name the boundary it belongs to
checks.remediation: Set boundary_ref on every generated entry (model-validatealignment verifies it names this software boundary and that entity and use-case references resolve)

checks.description: The model must carry its identity, type, and changelog
checks.remediation: Write the model-level D-02 fields; exactly one base UIModel exists per boundary

checks.description: The Markdown model must carry a changelog
checks.remediation: Add the changelog section (existing R-610 requirement)

checks.description: Entry IDs should follow the UME-[###] convention
checks.remediation: Use the UME-[###] zero-padded 3-digit format and preserve existing IDs on revision
